posts.zh:
dsh-opencode-usage 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。OpenCode Go 套餐用量显示：输入框下方常驻徽章显示滚动 / 每周 / 每月用量百分比与重置倒计时，点击展开进度卡片；Agent 可经 `opencode_go_usage` 工具随时查询余额。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c1a4235fb4c149e73744.html
posts.en:
dsh-opencode-usage is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. OpenCode Go plan usage display for the DSH web GUI: a persistent badge under the composer shows rolling/weekly/monthly usage percents with reset countdowns; click to expand a card; agents can query the balance via the `opencode_go_usage` tool.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c1a4235fb4c149e73744.html
